name: joey-agent
description: Use Joey paths, introductions and relationship context from your own AI agent. Record relationship and trust statements with your consent, and read their trust support.

defaultPrompt: Use $joey to show my Joey paths and the best next introduction.
Use $joey-make-intro to write the introduction request for <target>.
Use $joey-intro-follow-up to find the introductions that need a follow-up.
Use $joey-tracker-sync to update my Joey introduction tracker from my email and calendar.
Use $joey-attest to record the relationship and trust statements that I choose to share.
Use $joey-trust to show the relationship context and trust support for <person or agent>.
